name: search
description: One search over everything a person has: every record of every content type and every block on the canvas. A form with one field and one button, because that is the better thing here; it is a GET, so a search is a link that can be kept.

use.when: the person wants to find something by the words in it, from wherever they are; it belongs in the header, where they reach for it on every page.
use.not: filtering one list, which is the listing page, or asking the assistant, which is the chat.
use.with: the header at compact or icon size once the person knows it is there.

label.description: The visible label and the button text.

value.description: Words already typed, when showing results for them.

action.description: Where the search goes; the search page by default.

id.description: Id of the field, so the label reaches it.

a11y.role: search (a landmark) holding a labelled search field and a submit button

keyboard.does: moves to the field, then the button

wcag.notes: A visible label (3.3.2), a search landmark (1.3.1, 2.4.1), and a real form so it works without a script. The field is type=search, so assistive technology says what it is.

machine.identify: A form with role=search. The field is named q; the action is where results appear.
machine.operate: Type words into the field named q and submit, or GET the action with ?q=words; the same results are at /api/search?q=words.
